statement: The points $A(1,0,0)$, $B(0,1,0)$, $C(0,0,1)$ form a triangle. Find its area and the equation of the plane $ABC$.
solution: $\\overrightarrow{AB}=(-1,1,0)$, $\\overrightarrow{AC}=(-1,0,1)$. Their cross product is $(1,1,1)$, so area $=\\tfrac12|\\overrightarrow{AB}\\times\\overrightarrow{AC}|=\\tfrac{\\sqrt3}{2}$. A normal to the plane is $(1,1,1)$; through $C(0,0,1)$: $x+y+(z-1)=0$, i.e. $x+y+z=1$.
hints: Use the cross product for the area.
The normal is the cross product; plug in a point.
